tickets.subject: Need an Android + iOS app for our logistics company

messages.text: Hi, I need to build a mobile app for our logistics company.
Welcome to EmpowerTech! We build apps for Android, iOS, Windows, Mac, Web, and Linux using C#/.NET, Blazor, MAUI, and Azure. What platform are you targeting?
We need both Android and iOS with real-time tracking.
We build cross-platform apps using .NET MAUI which targets both Android and iOS from one codebase. Want to get in touch to discuss your project?
Yes please, how much will it cost?
We provide custom estimates based on your scope. Contact us at contact@empowertech.solutions for a free estimate!
